expectations.text: Cites the proposed rule: 91 FR 62361, published October 1, 2026, docket DOS-2026-0991
States it would remove and reserve USML Category VIII(h)(10), taking most radar altimeters off the Munitions List
expectations.evidence: "Removal of USML VIII(h)(10). Most radar altimeters would move off the USML."

expectations.text: Makes clear it is proposed only: current classifications remain in effect until a final rule
expectations.evidence: "the October 2026 omnibus is a PROPOSED rule only. Nothing has changed yet. Keep applying the current USML and 22 CFR rules until a final rule issues."

expectations.text: Mentions at least one other element (new 22 CFR 120.35 exclusions section, new 120.41 specially designed releases, or the new 123.26 OEM servicing exemption)
expectations.evidence: "A new 22 CFR 120.35 ... Two new 'specially designed' releases in 22 CFR 120.41 ... A new 22 CFR 123.26 exemption for the temporary export of foreign defense articles for OEM servicing and repair."

expectations.text: States comments are due November 30, 2026 and advises affected exporters to comment
expectations.evidence: "Comments are due November 30, 2026" and "Consider filing comments by November 30, 2026."
